Scientists in the Philippines have discovered a remarkable plant with a superpower: it can thrive in heavily polluted soil by sucking up toxic heavy metals without being harmed. The plant, named Rinorea niccolifera, was identified by researchers from the University of the Philippines Los Baños on Luzon Island. It belongs to a rare group of species known as hyperaccumulators. This hardy plant can absorb and store up to 18,000 parts per million of nickel in its leaves. 100 to 1,000 times more than typical plants can tolerate. It also effectively pulls cadmium and lead from the soil, safely storing the toxins in its tissues. The discovery highlights the potential of phytoremediation, an eco-friendly, low-cost technique that uses plants to naturally clean up contaminated land. Researchers believe Rinorea niccolifera could become a powerful tool for restoring ecosystems damaged by mining and industrial pollution.

आज नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी ने जिस प्रकार का कृत्य किया है, वह न केवल अशोभनीय है, बल्कि लोकतांत्रिक मर्यादाओं के भी विपरीत और अत्यंत निंदनीय है। नेता प्रतिपक्ष जिस गरिमा का पद है, उस पद को भी राहुल गांधी गंभीरता से नहीं लेते हैं, ये उनके व्यवहार में साफ दिखाई दिया। लोकतंत्र में विरोध करना प्रत्येक विपक्ष का अधिकार है, लेकिन विरोध और अराजकता में स्पष्ट अंतर होता है। जब विरोध अपनी मर्यादा की सीमाओं को लांघ देता है, तब वह अराजकता का रूप ले लेता है। हम लगातार कहते आए हैं कि राहुल गांधी आज रचनात्मक विपक्ष की बजाय अराजकता के प्रतीक बन कर रह गए हैं। संसदीय लोकतंत्र में कुछ पद ऐसे होते हैं, जो किसी एक दल के नहीं, बल्कि पूरे राष्ट्र के होते हैं। प्रधानमंत्री केवल किसी राजनीतिक दल के नेता नहीं, बल्कि 140 करोड़ देशवासियों द्वारा चुने गए जनप्रतिनिधि हैं। वे देश की जनता की आस्था, विश्वास और लोकतांत्रिक व्यवस्था के सर्वोच्च प्रतीकों में से एक हैं। ऐसे में प्रधानमंत्री आवास की ओर जिस प्रकार से माहौल को तनावपूर्ण और अव्यवस्थित बनाने का प्रयास किया गया, वह केवल राजनीतिक विरोध नहीं, बल्कि लोकतांत्रिक संस्थाओं और परंपराओं के प्रति असम्मान का परिचायक है। आज की घटना निश्चित रूप से दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है। भारत के राजनीतिक इतिहास का एक काला दिन है। हमने भी वर्षों तक विपक्ष में रहकर अपनी भूमिका निभाई है, लेकिन कभी लोकतांत्रिक मर्यादाओं और संसदीय परंपराओं का उल्लंघन नहीं किया। जिन मुद्दों को लेकर हमारे छात्र विषय रख रहे हैं, सरकार उस पर चर्चा करना चाहती है। राहुल गांधी ने स्वयं जो शर्तें रखीं, सरकार ने उन्हें भी स्वीकार किया। लेकिन जब संवाद और समाधान का अवसर आया, तो वे अपनी ही शर्तों और अपने ही रुख से पीछे हट गए। यह उनके राजनीतिक आचरण में अस्थिरता और अपरिपक्वता को स्पष्ट रूप से उजागर करता है। - श्री @NitinNabin Video

New Policy Brief | One Year of U.S. Tariffs: Shifts in India's Export Patterns FY 2025-26 marked the first full year of India–U.S. trade under the reciprocal tariff regime introduced on April 2, 2025 through Executive Order 14257, the most far-reaching U.S. tariff action in nearly a century. India was initially subjected to a 26% reciprocal tariff under a regime that saw several revisions over the year, measures made all the more consequential by India's overdependence on the U.S. market for its exports. With full-year trade data now released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, @NishaTaneja20, Sanjana Joshi, Vasudha Upreti, Pratik Tiwary, and Yashika Khatri trace the evolution of the tariff measures, assess India's dependence on the U.S. market, examine how exports performed across markets, and evaluate the extent to which affected exports were absorbed elsewhere. Their brief reviews the Government of India's response, from longstanding diversification policies to the renewed push that followed the tariff episode, and sets out recommendations to deepen market diversification and strengthen resilience against market-specific policy shocks. Nietzsche said a lot of contradictory stuff but one of his most consistent ideas is that archaic western culture used to value brute strength for its own sake but Judeo-Christianity inverted the relationship between strength and goodness and encouraged the strong to feel guilt and pity for the weak. He revered Homer's Odysseus much more than a contemporary Christian priest. So it's funny that Nolan made The Odyssey kinda Christian—accentuating the main character's guilt, trauma—and then many Christian conservatives, who decided that they were going to hate the movie because it had a Black actress in the wrong role, instead have to twist themselves into the pretzel of arguing that making the Odyssey Christian is "woke" and they just really wanted to see a movie and hero that properly embodied the very same archaic and anti-Christian values that in any other context they would consider abhorrent. Matt Walsh (@MattWalshBlog) Just saw The Odyssey. Despite what you may have heard, literally all of the criticisms by conservatives were entirely correct. The movie is just as woke as you fear, if not more so. The DEI casting is atrocious. Completely takes you out of the story right from the beginning. But even worse than that is Nolan’s decision to turn Odysseus into an anachronistic whiney, solemn shell of a man plagued by “trauma” and guilt. It’s impossible to overlook these flaws because the film itself is not terribly entertaining or well constructed. For the most part it is disjointed, dull, self-serious, disenchanted, somehow feeling both verbose and overly rushed at the same time. The dialogue is some of the worst I’ve ever heard in a “critically acclaimed” film. “On the nose” and “clunky” are descriptions that can’t even begin to describe this script. At no point in the story does Nolan ever transport the audience to the ancient world. You never feel like you’re 3,000 years in the past. You feel like you’re watching modern Americans put on a pageant, because you are. Nobody would be calling this thing a masterpiece if it was made by a director not named Christopher Nolan. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MattWalshBlog/status/2079385765402833029#m

प्राइवेट नौकरी वालों को भी पेंशन का तोहफा, EPFO 3.0 में सरकार बना रही रिटायरमेंट का मास्टर प्लान EPFO Pension Scheme: 60 साल के बाद पेंशन आर्थिक सुरक्षा देती है. सरकारी नौकरीपेशा लोगों को रिटारमेंट के बाद हर महीने एक निश्चित रकम पेंशन के तौर पर मिलती है,ये सुविधा प्राइवेट नौकरी करने वालों को नहीं मिल पाती है. EPFO अब पेंशन से जुड़े बड़े बदलाव की तैयारी कर रहा है. EPFO एक ऐसी यूनिवर्सल पेंशन योजना पर काम कर रही है, जिसमें प्राइवेट कर्मचारी, गिग वर्कर, फ्रीलांसर, छोटे कारोबार से जुड़े लोग भी पेंशन योजना का लाभ पा सकेंगे. अगर ऐसा होता है, तो सरकारी कर्मचारियों के साथ-साथ करोड़ों लोगों को सोशल सिक्योरिटी मिल जाएगी. हालांकि अभी इस प्रस्ताव पर विचार ही किया जा रहा है, आधिकारिक तौर पर इसकी जानकारी सामने नहीं आई है. . . सरकार EPFO 3.0 के तहत देश की सामाजिक सुरक्षा व्यवस्था में बड़ा बदलाव करने की तैयारी कर रही है, जिसमें संगठित क्षेत्र के अलावा गिग वर्कर्स, प्लेटफॉर्म वर्कर्स, सेल्फ इम्प्लॉय लोगों तक पेंशन की सुरक्षा पहुंच सकेगी. नई कंट्रीब्यूटरी पेंशन स्कीम में लोगों को लंबे समय तक सरकारी स्कीम में निवेश करना होगा, जिसपर सालाना ब्याज भी मिलेगा . 60 साल की उम्र में स्कीम को TRS यानी Target Retirment Sum में बदलने की सुविधा होगी. आपको रिटारमेंट के समय कितना फंड चाहिए, इसके आधार पर आप हर महीने, सालाना ईपीएफओ में बचत करेंगे. आप अनुमानित पेंशन, सेविंग, रिटायरमेंट फंड जैसी तमाम डिटेल को अपने डिजिटल डैशबोर्ड पर देख सकेंगे. रिटारमेंट के बाद पेंशन पाने के लिए आपको दो विकल्प मिलेंगे. आप अपनी जमा रकम को Annuity Plan या Systematic Withdrawal Plan चुन सकेंगे. एन्युएटी प्लान में हर महीने आपको तय पेंशन मिलेगा. जबकि SWP प्लान के तहत आप अपनी जरूरत के मुताबिक अपने रिटायरमेंट फंड से पैसा निकाल सकेंगे. इस योजना की सबसे बड़ी खासियत है कि इसमें सिर्फ कर्मचारी या कंपनी नहीं, बल्कि गिग वर्कर्स, CSR फंड, NGO, श्रमिक सब जुड़ सकेंगे. नई योजना NPS स्कीम से अलग होगी. नेशनल पेंशन सिस्टम में रिटायरमेंट के बाद आपको एकमुश्त रकम एन्युटी में मिल जाती है. जबकि ईपीएफओ की नई स्कीम में अंशधारक के पास यह चुनने का विकल्प होगा कि वो जमा रकम को एक साथ लेना चाहता है या ब्याज की रकम को हर महीने पेंशन के तौर पर लेना चाहता है , जहां मूल रकम सुरक्षित जमा रहेगी या समय-समय पर अपनी जरूरत के हिसाब से निकालना चाहता है. #EPFO #Pension #PrivateJobs

645 million people faced hunger in 2025, while a healthy diet remained unaffordable for 2.7 billion people. Explore the key findings of the 2026 edition of The State of Food Security & Nutrition in the World by @FAO @IFAD @UNICEF @WFP & @WHO 👉 bit.ly/4yCaiuU #SOFI2026

Hunger has declined for a third consecutive year. That is welcome progress and proof that coordinated action and investment can make a difference. However, #SOFI2026 also warns that progress remains fragile. Nearly 2.7 billion people may still be unable to afford a healthy diet. Affordability is a whole-value-chain issue. It depends on resilient production, affordable inputs, effective storage and processing, functioning markets and decent incomes for small-scale producers. Climate shocks, conflict, inflation and disruptions to energy, transport and trade affect this chain. That is why integrated investment in production, value chains and market systems is so important. The evidence shows this works. IFAD-supported projects increased participants’ incomes, production and market access by at least 34 per cent. Where strong private-sector engagement was included, income gains reached 64 per cent. @IFAD's focus on nutrition is cross cutting. We approach nutrition as a food systems outcome integrated across our investments. Scaling up investment in resilient food systems and value chains that connect rural producers to opportunity and consumers to affordable and nutritious food. SOFI 2026 gives us the evidence. Interior Minister of Iran H.E. Iskander Momeni called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 21 July 2026.

ISLAMABAD: 21 July 2026. H.E. Mr. Eskandar Momeni, Interior Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran, who is on an official visit to Pakistan, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House, earlier today. Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Minister for Interior & Narcotics Control Syed Mohsin Raza Naqvi, Minister for Information Attaullah Tarar, Advisor to the Prime Minister Dr. Syed Tauqir Shah, Minister of State for Interior Talal Chaudhry and other senior government officials were also present. During the meeting, the Prime Minister welcomed the Iranian Interior Minister and his delegation to Pakistan. While recalling his visit to Tehran, earlier this month, to attend the funeral ceremony of the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Sayyid Ali Khamenei, the Prime Minister conveyed his respectful regards and good wishes for Supreme Leader His Eminence Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei and President Dr. Masoud Pezeshkian. The Prime Minister shared his deep concern over the recent escalation in the Gulf region and urged all sides to exercise restraint and refrain from actions that could further destabilize the region. While emphasizing that Pakistan would continue to play its role as an honest and sincere mediator and facilitator, the Prime Minister reiterated Pakistan’s strong commitment to regional peace and stability. Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni thanked the Prime Minister for the warm welcome accorded to him and his delegation in Islamabad. He conveyed greetings and best wishes of the Iranian leadership. He stated that he was leading a delegation of senior government officials to enhance bilateral ties. The Iranian Minister expressed deep appreciation for the Prime Minister, Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir for their untiring mediation efforts that led to the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding. He also expressed gratitude for the Prime Minister’s visit to Tehran to attend the funeral ceremony of late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Sayyid Ali Khamenei. Video

मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता ने दिल्ली के लाल डोरा एवं आबादी क्षेत्रों में संचालित स्वामित्व योजना की प्रगति की समीक्षा की। ▸ योजना के तहत 48 गांवों को शामिल किया गया है। इनमें से अब तक 30 गांवों का ड्रोन सर्वेक्षण पूरा हो चुका है और उनके अंतिम प्रॉपर्टी कार्ड तैयार हैं। ▸ अब तक 12,232 संपत्तियों का सर्वेक्षण किया जा चुका है। इनमें 8,423 विवाद-मुक्त संपत्तियों के लिए क्यूआर कोड युक्त स्मार्ट पीवीसी प्रॉपर्टी कार्ड जारी करने की प्रक्रिया अंतिम चरण में है। ▸ डिजिटल संपत्ति अभिलेख तैयार किए जा रहे हैं तथा रिकॉर्ड को DORIS से जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया भी जारी है। स्वामित्व योजना से दिल्ली के ग्रामीणों को उनकी संपत्तियों का प्रमाणिक डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड मिलेगा। इससे वर्षों से चली आ रही समस्याओं का समाधान होगा और संपत्ति संबंधी सेवाएं अधिक सरल, तेज और पारदर्शी बनेंगी।

केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय द्वारा दिल्ली नगर निगम अधिनियम, 1957 की चौदहवीं अनुसूची में संशोधन करते हुए दिल्ली नगर निगम के जोनों के नामों को राजस्व जिलों के अनुरूप एकरूप किया गया है। इससे विभिन्न विभाग एक ही क्षेत्र की पहचान एक ही नाम से करेंगे। परिणामस्वरूप विभागों के बीच बेहतर समन्वय स्थापित होगा, योजनाओं के क्रियान्वयन में गति आएगी और नागरिकों तक सरकारी सेवाएं अधिक सरल, तेज तथा प्रभावी ढंग से पहुंच सकेंगी। एक समान प्रशासनिक नामकरण के माध्यम से सुशासन को और सशक्त बनाने तथा जनसुविधाओं को बेहतर करने की दिशा में यह एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है।

A 29-year-old volunteer died of heart failure after exhausting himself while delivering emergency supplies to #flood-hit communities in South China's #Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, local media reported. Dang Xinrui, a railway operations controller from Sichuan province, had been on annual leave for a trip to Yunnan province when he learned that volunteers were urgently needed in Guangxi. He immediately changed his plans, traveled to Nanning and joined a relief team. Early July flooding, triggered by Typhoon Maysak, left villages in Hengzhou cut off after roads and bridges were washed away. Before dawn on July 14, Dang and his teammates set out, each carrying about 15 kilograms of medicines, vegetables and other essential supplies. After a six-hour trek along muddy mountain paths, they reached Jiucun of Heyuan village, where residents stranded by floodwaters finally received the much-needed aid. After only a brief rest, the group began the return journey. Dang later complained of dizziness before collapsing. His teammates immediately performed CPR while waiting for medical help. Flood-damaged roads forced medical workers to carry emergency equipment on foot to reach him. Despite more than three hours of resuscitation efforts, Dang could not be revived. #EverydayHero

خان چیمہ، شزا فاطمہ خواجہ اور متعلقہ حکام کی تعریف کی۔ انہوں نے ہدایت کی کہ تمام وزارتیں اس نظام کو اختیار کرتے ہوئے اس کے تحت امور سرانجام دیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ اب روایتی انداز میں فائلیں لے کر گھومنے کی ضرورت نہیں، تمام امور اس جدید نظام کے ذریعے نمٹائے جائیں۔ اس موقع پر وفاقی وزیر احد خان چیمہ نے کہا کہ جدید طرز حکمرانی کے لئے مصنوعی ذہانت اور ڈیٹا پر مبنی نظام فعال کر دیا گیا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ یہ جدید نظام حکومتی فیصلوں میں شفافیت اور بروقت اقدامات کے حوالے سے انتہائی اہم ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ وزیراعظم کی ہدایت کی روشنی میں فیصلہ سازی میں جدید ٹیکنالوجی بروئے کار لائی جا رہی ہے، مؤثر پالیسی سازی اور ڈیٹا پر مبنی نتائج کے لئے یہ نظام انتہائی اہم ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ پرانے نظام میں تمام تقاضے پورے نہیں ہوتے تھے اور آؤٹ پٹ سے مکمل استفادہ نہیں کیا جا سکتا تھا، اس لئے ان خامیوں کو دور کرتے ہوئے یہ جدید نظام متعارف کرایا گیا ہے، پرانے نظام میں کئی اقدامات اور عوامل موجود نہیں تھے جن کو اس نئے نظام کا حصہ بنایا گیا ہے۔ وفاقی وزیر آئی ٹی شزہ فاطمہ خواجہ نے وزیراعظم آفس سسٹم سے متعلق بریفنگ میں بتایا کہ وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف نے بطور وزیراعلیٰ ماضی میں ڈیجیٹائزیشن کا آغاز کیا تھا جس کے بعد اب ہم ڈیجیٹل سے اے آئی کی طرف گامزن ہیں اور تمام شعبوں میں جدید ٹیکنالوجی بروئے کار لا رہے ہیں، سماجی تحفظ کے سب سے بڑے پروگرام کو بھی ڈیجیٹائز کر دیا گیا ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ پیپر لیس طرز حکمرانی کی طرف جا رہے ہیں، وزیراعظم آفس سسٹم سے کارکردگی اور خود احتسابی کا عمل بہتر ہوگا۔ وزیراعظم کو اس جدید نظام کے بارے میں دی گئی بریفنگ کے مطابق ’’وزیراعظم آفس سسٹم‘‘ (پی ایم او ایس) پاکستان کا پہلا مصنوعی ذہانت سے چلنے والا نظام ہے، یہ وزیراعظم آفس کا سرکاری ڈیجیٹل پلیٹ فارم ہے جس کا مقصد وزیراعظم کے احکامات جاری ہونے سے لے کر ان پر عملدرآمد، ان کی تکمیل اور تکمیل کے بعد نگرانی تک تمام امور کی انجام دہی کا خودکار نظام متعارف کرانا ہے۔ یہ نظام گورننس اور شفافیت کے لئے سنگ میل اور حکومت کی معاشی ترجیحات اور خدمات کی فراہمی کے ضمن میں انتہائی کارآمد ثابت ہوگا۔ اس نظام کے ذریعے وزیراعظم کی طرف سے ان کے احکامات کی ڈیڈ لائنز کی نشاندہی اور انہیں اجاگر کرنے میں مدد ملے گی اور وزارتوں کی جوابدہی Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, today, launched the Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Prime Minister Office System (PMOS), describing it as a transformative digital platform that will modernise governance by recording, communicating, monitoring and tracking every directive issued by the Prime Minister from issuance through implementation, verified completion and post-completion monitoring. Addressing the launch ceremony at the Prime Minister's Office, the prime minister directed all relevant authorities to ensure the immediate and full implementation of the new AI-based system, making it clear that traditional paper-based working would be replaced by digital processes. "From today onwards, I will not expect any of you with a file in your hands. Everything will be discussed through this mechanism," the prime minister said. He praised Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunication Shaza Fatima Khawaja and Secretary IT for their efforts in developing and operationalising the system. He urged all ministries and government departments to adopt the platform, saying it would significantly improve the government's ability to deliver results. "This would make service delivery easier," he remarked. The ceremony was attended by Minister for Economic Affairs Ahad Khan Cheema, Minister for Information Technology Shaza Fatima Khawaja, and other senior officials. During the ceremony, the prime minister was given a comprehensive briefing on the AI-powered platform and its objectives. The prime minister was informed that PMOS was the first government platform in Pakistan to integrate artificial intelligence as a central component of decision-making and implementation monitoring, calling it a trailblazer for the digital transformation of the federal government. According to the briefing, PMOS had been developed at the centre of government to ensure efficient communication of the prime minister's directives throughout the government machinery while enabling timely implementation in accordance with defined quality standards. The system also serves as a secure technology-driven decision-support platform by integrating analytics and structured information within a protected IT environment. During the briefing, it was informed that PMOS would facilitate continuous policy calibration by enabling the government to utilise technological, human and financial resources more effectively to generate better economic outcomes. By introducing the platform at the Prime Minister's Office, the government intends to embed governance reforms at the highest level before extending them across the wider administrative structure. At the heart of the platform is a comprehensive digital repository that records every directive issued by the prime minister together with the complete chain of implementation, making PMOS both an institutional knowledge base and a permanent record of government decision-making. Unlike conventional government tracking systems, the briefing explained, PMOS incorporates an artificial intelligence layer capable of reading, classifying and analysing directives rather than merely storing them. ২০২৬ বিশ্বকাপের ফাইনালে দুর্দান্ত খেলতে থাকা স্পেনের বিপক্ষে আর্জেন্টিনার পক্ষে বলতে গেলে একাই লড়েছেন এমিলিয়ানো মার্টিনেজ। দুর্দান্ত সব রিফ্লেক্স সেভ করে দলকে বাঁচানোর সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করেছিলেন, কিন্তু অতিরিক্ত সময়ে ফেরান তোরেসের গোল ঠেকাতে পারেননি। ম্যাচের পর সামাজিক মাধ্যমে দেওয়া বার্তায় তিনি কাউকে দোষারোপ করেননি; বরং টানা দ্বিতীয়বার বিশ্বকাপ জয়ের স্বপ্ন ভেঙে যাওয়ার বেদনা প্রকাশ করেছেন। সেই সঙ্গে আর্জেন্টিনা জাতীয় দলে তার ভবিষ্যৎ নিয়ে এমন একটি প্রশ্ন তুলেছেন, যা কেউই আশা করেনি। কঠিন এই পরাজয় মেনে নিতে মার্টিনেজের কয়েক ঘণ্টা সময় লেগেছিল। পরে মঙ্গলবার (২১ জুলাই) বুয়েনস আইরেসে ফিরেন তিনি, যেখানে সন্ধ্যার প্রবল ঠান্ডা ও বৃষ্টি উপেক্ষা করে অসংখ্য সমর্থক তাকে স্বাগত জানান। তিনি ইনস্টাগ্রামে হৃদয়বিদারক এক বার্তায় লিখেছেন, 'আমি স্বপ্ন দেখেছিলাম আমরা আবারও বিশ্বকাপ জিতব। স্বপ্ন দেখেছিলাম ট্রফিটা আবার আর্জেন্টিনায় নিয়ে যাব এবং নতুন ইতিহাস গড়ব।' এরপরই তিনি এমন একটি মন্তব্য করেন, যা আর্জেন্টাইনদের বিস্ময়ে বিহ্বল করেছে। দ্রুত ঘুরে দাঁড়িয়ে আবার জাতীয় দলের হয়ে প্রতিশোধ নেওয়ার কথা না বলে তিনি নিজের ভবিষ্যৎ নিয়েই অনিশ্চয়তার ইঙ্গিত দেন। মার্টিনেজ লিখেছেন, 'সত্যি বলতে, এই কষ্ট ভাষায় প্রকাশ করা কঠিন। অনেক কিছু নিয়ে ভাবতে হবে, সামনে কীভাবে এগোব তা নিয়ে সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে হবে। হয়তো এখন সময় এসেছে সরে দাঁড়ানোর।' সংক্ষিপ্ত হলেও এই বক্তব্য ছিল অত্যন্ত শক্তিশালী। কারণ ২০২১ সালের ৩ জুন চিলির বিপক্ষে বিশ্বকাপ বাছাইপর্বের ম্যাচে অভিষেকের পর থেকেই এমি মার্টিনেজ নিজেকে শুধু একজন অসাধারণ গোলরক্ষক হিসেবেই নয়, বরং দলের অন্যতম নেতা হিসেবেও প্রতিষ্ঠিত করেছেন। লিওনেল মেসিসহ সতীর্থদের কাছে তিনি একজন স্বাভাবিক অনুপ্রেরণাদাতা এবং দলের ইতিবাচক পরিবেশ গড়ে তোলার অন্যতম প্রধান কারিগর। নিজের পোস্টের শেষ দিকে, যেখানে রানার্স-আপ পদকে চুমু খাওয়া থেকে শুরু করে বিশ্বকাপ শিরোপা খুইয়ে অঝোরে কাঁদার ছবিও ছিল, মার দেল প্লাতার এই গোলরক্ষক সমর্থকদের কাছে ক্ষমা চেয়ে লেখেন, 'আমি সত্যিই দুঃখিত। আমার দেশ এবং আমার সতীর্থদের সাহায্য করার জন্য আমি সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করেছি।' জর্ডানের বিপক্ষে গ্রুপ পর্বে মাত্র একটি গোল হজম করার পর নকআউট পর্বে নিজের নামের প্রতি সুবিচার করতে ব্যর্থ হন মার্টিনেজ। পরের তিন ম্যাচে (কেপ ভার্দের বিপক্ষে দুটি, মিশরের বিপক্ষে দুটি এবং সুইজারল্যান্ডের বিপক্ষে একটি) মোট পাঁচ গোল হজম করেন। তবে সেমিফাইনালে ইংল্যান্ডের বিপক্ষে আবারও তিনি প্রমাণ New Policy Brief | Fiscal Implications of Geopolitical Disruptions for India's Fertiliser Sector For decades, India's fertiliser subsidy regime has shielded farmers from volatility in global fertiliser and energy markets. But by insulating domestic prices from international movements, it also transmits sharp increases in global fertiliser, feedstock, and energy prices straight into higher subsidy expenditure. The disruption of the Strait of Hormuz in late February 2026, the principal maritime corridor for India's imports of urea, DAP, LNG, ammonia, and sulphur has brought this vulnerability into sharp focus. Assessing three scenarios for FY27, Ritika Juneja, Sachchida Nand, Emil Thomas Johny, and Ashok Gulati estimate that the fertiliser subsidy, budgeted at INR 1.71 trillion, could rise to between INR 2.42 and 3.32 trillion, or about 0.6–0.8% of GDP. The brief argues the crisis is less a temporary supply disruption than a stress test of India's fertiliser policy, exposing heavy import dependence, the continued price control of urea, distortions in the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework, and the absence of strategic reserves. It proposes a reform agenda spanning gradual decontrol of urea through a farmer-centric DBT mechanism, rationalisation of the NBS framework, diversification of import sources and feedstocks, strategic fertiliser reserves, and investment in green ammonia, arguing that fertiliser security must be treated as a strategic national priority. The discussion lies beyond cell manufacturing as India's battery ecosystem remains heavily dependent on imported processed critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel and graphite. Strengthening upstream capabilities, including critical mineral processing and refining, active battery materials, recycling, and sustained investment in research and development, is equally essential for building a resilient, competitive, and strategically secure battery value chain. With critical mineral supply chains increasingly influenced by geoeconomic and strategic considerations, India's policy focus should extend beyond cell manufacturing to developing resilient upstream capabilities, reducing supply chain risks, and increasing domestic value addition across the battery ecosystem. Росіяни атакували звичайну багатоповерхівку. Горять квартири з першого по сьомий поверх. Усі служби працюють на місцях – залучені рятувальники, медики, – роблять усе, щоб допомогти людям. Були сьогодні удари й по Херсону КАБами, дронами різних типів, зокрема FPV. Двоє поранених, і, на жаль, є одна загибла людина. Мої співчуття рідним. Є удари по Одесі та області. Росіяни завдали ракетного удару по звичайному парку. Атакували місто також реактивними дронами. Пошкодили чотириповерховий житловий будинок, автомобілі. Двох людей було поранено. І дуже важливо, щоб запити на озброєння від корпусів, на засоби протидії росіянам – усе те, про що ми говорили з військовими та урядовцями, – були швидше поставлені виробниками. The ‘Peace Ship’, powered by nuclear energy, launched on this day in 1959. Officially known as the NS Savannah, it was the world’s first nuclear-powered merchant ship and second-ever nuclear-powered civilian vessel. Former US President Dwight Eisenhower liked to call it the ‘Peace Ship’, as it was built as part of the 1950s ‘Atoms for Peace’ initiative for demonstrating the potential peaceful uses of nuclear energy. This vast 600-foot (182 meter) long, almost 80-foot (24 meter) wide ship was powered by a pressurized water reactor. It had seven cargo holds and could accommodate 60 passengers in its 30 staterooms, dining hall, swimming pool, library, and even cinema. After six years of carrying passengers and cargo, the Savannah was covert into a freight-only vessel until it was retired in 1971.

Global hunger declined for a third consecutive year in 2025, according to the 2026 edition of The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World (#SOFI2026) report. But progress remains fragile and uneven – with food insecurity still highest in rural areas and among women. An estimated 645 million people faced hunger in 2025, while 2.1 billion experienced moderate or severe food insecurity – still above pre-pandemic levels. Healthy diets are becoming more expensive and, despite improvements, affordability varies sharply across regions. In Africa, 66.6% of people could not afford a healthy diet in 2025. “Our task now is to turn the evidence SOFI provides into investment - and to do so through partnership. Together, we can build the value chains, market systems and rural economies that make healthy food affordable for all.” said @IFADPresident Alvaro Lario. Prezydent zawetował ją, ponieważ wkraczała ona w obszar zarezerwowany dla instytucji małżeństwa, chronionej przez art. 18 polskiej Konstytucji. Chodzi przede wszystkim o złamanie ładu konstytucyjnego. Mamy instytucję małżeństwa określoną w art. 18 Konstytucji, a ta ustawa wkracza w obszar zarezerwowany dla przepisów polskiego prawa, konstytucji i kodeksu rodzinnego i opiekuńczego, dając związkom nieformalnym przywileje dotąd przynależne małżeństwu. 💬 Udzielanie wsparcia militarnego Ukrainie, to wspólny interes NATO i Unii Europejskiej, żeby chronić wschodnią flankę i nie mieć u granic Federacji Rosyjskiej. Ukrainę należy wspierać, ale równocześnie wywierać presję dla naszych interesów historycznych i gospodarczych. Musimy jednak oddzielić politykę bieżącą – czyli konieczność wojskowego wspierania Ukrainy w walce z Rosją – od naszej polityki historycznej, gdzie powinniśmy twardo ubiegać się o swoje sprawy. prezydent.pl/kancelaria/akty…

This is something I think prediction market people don't take seriously enough. I've often heard prediction markets called "truth engines", but too often their backers forget that they're not predicting The Thing but a simulacrum of The Thing. A market for temperature was cheated when someone found the actual sensor used to measure the temperature, placed a big bet on HOT, and ran a hair dryer on the sensor to make the it hotter. The market was for the sensor, not the actual weather. There are similar ways to cheat all sorts of markets that aren't being used right now, but will be used if the monetary incentives grow strong enough. Paying trial participants to lie. Paying athletes to change how they play. Paying insiders to insert specific words into speeches. I've been fascinated by the potential of prediction markets for a long time, but I don't think they worry enough about the trust-eroding implications of this kind of thing happening at scale. Matt Holtz 🌐🇺🇸🇺🇦 (@Diplomatt42) Prediction markets would be terrible for clinical trials. There’s not much stopping a large gambler from paying participants to report a few fake serious adverse events and potentially derail an early phase drug. Phase 1 trials already have risks of professional patients as it is — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Diplomatt42/status/2079196103904580007#m

New Policy Brief | One Year of U.S. Tariffs: Shifts in India's Export Patterns FY 2025-26 marked the first full year of India–U.S. trade under the reciprocal tariff regime introduced on April 2, 2025 through Executive Order 14257, the most far-reaching U.S. tariff action in nearly a century. India was initially subjected to a 26% reciprocal tariff under a regime that saw several revisions over the year, measures made all the more consequential by India's overdependence on the U.S. market for its exports. With full-year trade data now released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, @NishaTaneja20, Sanjana Joshi, Vasudha Upreti, Pratik Tiwary, and Yashika Khatri trace the evolution of the tariff measures, assess India's dependence on the U.S. market, examine how exports performed across markets, and evaluate the extent to which affected exports were absorbed elsewhere. Their brief reviews the Government of India's response, from longstanding diversification policies to the renewed push that followed the tariff episode, and sets out recommendations to deepen market diversification and strengthen resilience against market-specific policy shocks. Nineteen years ago, Suvendu Adhikari led the resistance at Singur and Nandigram that stopped the Tata Nano. It broke 34 years of Communist rule, and made forced land acquisition politically radioactive in West Bengal. The same man has become Chief Minister, beating Mamata Banerjee in her own seat. And now he has announced a land policy for industry that is, quietly, almost identical to the one Mamata's government adopted in 2014, and to what the Left Front reached for after Nandigram. Three governments, three bitter rivals, have all come up with the same answer — buy land only from willing sellers, never seize it. Here is the trap. - That approach works well for factory expansions and reviving closed plants. - It falls apart the moment Bengal wants a genuinely large greenfield project, the 1,000-acre kind that would actually shift the state's share of Indian industry. And the reason it falls apart is buried in something the Left Front itself did in the 1980s, which still shapes who can sell land in Bengal today. Every state Bengal is trying to imitate solved this years ago, with an institution that Bengal never built. Adhikari has not said how he will build it now, or where the money would come from with the state this deep in debt. This piece by @bingaspeaks traces why every Bengal land policy since Singur has really been a policy about Singur, and whether Adhikari can be the one to break the pattern. swarajyamag.com/west-bengal/…

1/5: Can India qualify for the FIFA World Cup in 2034? The answer is probably not. And it would be unwise to present it as a promise. The honest thing to do would be to treat 2034 as a national deadline to build a football system capable of mounting a credible World Cup challenge. 2/5: India remains far from the standards required to qualify from Asia. Our national team lacks consistency, and our development system does not produce footballers capable of competing at the highest level. These realities should be acknowledged without defensiveness. So what does it need to do? 3/5: The real focus must be the Indian player. The footballers who could take India to 2034 are between 12 and 20 years old today. We need transparent district-level scouting, quality academies, youth leagues, better coaches, sports science, and regular exposure to stronger opposition. 4/5: No single institution can deliver this. The AIFF, clubs, central and state governments, schools, universities, corporates, broadcasters, the Armed Forces and former players all have a role. This has to become a national football compact with clear responsibilities and measurable outcomes, not a collection of disconnected schemes. 5/5: A credible 2034 World Cup challenge begins with an honest assessment of where Indian football stands today and what can be built. Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today joined the ASEAN Foreign Ministers in the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM) in Manila, the Philippines. The Meeting was chaired by the Chair of AMM 2026 and Secretary of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Philippines, H.E. Ma. Theresa P. Lazaro. Dr. Kao briefed the Ministers on the progress in ASEAN Community-building efforts, including the follow-up to Leaders' decisions since the 48th ASEAN Summit and the implementation of ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future. The Ministers reaffirmed their commitment to supporting the Philippines in realising its Chairship deliverables this year under the theme “Navigating Our Future Together.”

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today attended the Opening Ceremony of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM), in Manila, the Philippines. The Ceremony marked the commencement of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, Post-Ministerial Conferences, and Related Meetings, on 21-24 July 2026.

On 19 July 2026, the Executive Committee of the Commission on the Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone (SEANWFZ EXCOM) convened in Manila to review the progress in the implementation of the Plan of Action to Strengthen the Implementation of the SEANWFZ Treaty (2023-2027) and reaffirmed ASEAN's strong commitment to preserving Southeast Asia as a Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone to advancing global nuclear disarmament and non-proliferation. Syria’s trajectory—from the outbreak of anti-regime protests in 2011 to the fall of Bashar al-Assad in 2024 and the subsequent leadership transition—provides a better set of lessons for understanding the question of regime change in Iran. For years, Syria reinforced a familiar set of assumptions about regime survival: Regimes entrenched for half a century cannot collapse; regime change requires a coherent opposition or ready-made successor; external powers must deploy ground forces to shift the balance—and even then, such interventions may fail, as in Iraq. These assumptions matter because Iran is often viewed through the same flawed lens. Today's Ramsar Spotlight takes us to Bhitarkanika Mangroves in Odisha. The name Bhitarkanika comes from the Odia words 'Bhitar' (interior) and 'Kanika' (extraordinarily beautiful). Once the private residence and hunting grounds of the kings of the erstwhile Kingdom of Kanika, the region is also remembered through the legend of 'Kalia', a colossal saltwater crocodile said to have ruled the Dhamra River for nearly a century. Today, Bhitarkanika continues to preserve Odisha's rich cultural heritage through its historic temples and traditional Nalia grass crafts. #WetlandsofIndia

هادیه در ۱۳ سالگی وادار به ازدواج شد. چهار سال پس از ازدواج باردار شد، اما جنین‌اش در رحم از بین رفت. ۱۸ ماه قبل بار دیگر باردار شد و این بار کودکش به دنیا آمد. اکنون کودک او به سوءتغذیه شدید مبتلا است. هادیه با شوهر ۲۸ ساله‌اش در ولسوالی دورافتاده‌ی «اتغر» ولایت زابل، در جنوب کشور و هم‌مرز با پاکستان، زندگی می‌کند. در روستای محل زندگی آنان نه پرستار زن وجود دارد و نه قابله. هادیه در صحبت با روزنامه اطلاعات روز می‌گوید که هنگام بارداری دوم، رحمش زخم برداشت و همین موضوع باعث شد که هنگام تولد فرزندش درد و رنج بسیار زیادی را تحمل کند. زمستان سال گذشته، همسر هادیه او را با یک ریکشای باربری، پس از یک ساعت راه، به یک مرکز درمانی در ولسوالی «اتغر» منتقل کرد؛ مرکزی که امکانات درمانی کافی نداشت. او گفت: «کودک من به سوءتغذیه مبتلا شده است و دو ماه می‌شود که در شفاخانه در دستگاه مراقبت از نوزاد سپری کرده است اما وضعیت او خوب نشده است.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257696

اداره آمادگی مبارزه با حوادث اعلام کرده است که در پی بارندگی‌های شدید، سیلاب‌ها در شهر پارون، مرکز ولایت نورستان، جاری شده و تلفات جانی و خسارات مالی برجا گذاشته است. این اداره در خبرنامه‌ای گفته است: «مسؤولان ریاست آمادگی مبارزه با حوادث ولایت نورستان به محل رویداد رسیده‌اند و عملیات جست‌وجوی شهدا و زخمیان و نجات را آغاز کرده‌اند.» براساس معلومات این اداره، آمار ابتدایی تلفات و خسارات پس از بررسی و ارزیابی با رسانه‌ها شریک خواهد شد. فریدون صمیم، سخنگوی والی نورستان، می‌گوید که در پی سیلاب‌های امروز در شهر پارون، شمار زیادی از افراد ناپدید شده و زیر آوار ساختمان‌ها گیر مانده‌اند. The dusk of a clear day is when Zhangye Colorful Danxia displays its most vibrant colors. As the daytime heat slowly fades, the slanting sunlight spills across the ridgelines, gradually illuminating the reds, oranges, and yellows hidden deep within the valleys. Layer upon layer of sandstone hills shift from soft pink to blazing orange, each band etched by mineral deposits and the passage of time. Over millions of years, wind and erosion have sculpted the landscape into a vast natural canvas awash with color. Arrive at the viewing platform before sunset, and you'll see hot-air balloons drifting lazily above the rainbow-colored hills. Daily Ukraine map thread for Monday 20th July 2026 Russian shelling of Ukrainian positions in western Donetsk indicates further Ukrainian advances around Voskresenka, Piddubne and Myrne. We've considered this area to be contested since 13th June, so this is an evolution of an existing situation rather than a sudden breakthrough. If you're using other maps, these locations may still appear well inside Russian-controlled territory. Don't mistake delayed mapping updates elsewhere for a dramatic overnight change and get overly excited. Ukrainian assault regiments have continued clearing Russian infiltrators from settlements within our blue-controlled areas where Russian flags had previously appeared. During these operations, Ukrainian forces reportedly captured 64 Russian prisoners over a relatively short period around the Ternuvate/Kosivtseve area. Elsewhere, Ukraine remains under severe pressure around Kostyantynivka and west of Siversk, where Russian forces continue to make gains. It is also very plausible that Russian reconnaissance or infiltration teams have already reached Kramatorsk to establish observation posts or liaise with sympathetic local contacts. If so, these would almost certainly be trained personnel attempting to remain concealed rather than conducting obvious propaganda stunts such as flag-raising. Meanwhile, the Crimean interdiction campaign continues to expand. Ukrainian Unmanned Systems have progressively extended strikes to the southernmost chain of electrical substations along Crimea's southern coast. Shipping and ferry assets have again been targeted, with further attacks appearing very likely this evening. Yeysk Air Base on the eastern side of the Sea of Azov was also struck, reportedly disabling at least three radar systems and a Tor-M2 air defence system. Across the occupied territories, Ukrainian long-range strikes against Russian logistics continue to disrupt supply routes, ammunition movement and rear-area infrastructure. The cumulative effect has become increasingly apparent throughout this year and the pace of the campaign continues to increase. You can use our map to compare March of this year, where it first became noticable that this new capability was truly underway, to July where strikes occur very deep indeed and in greater number. While there remains a considerable distance to go before these disruptions can be fully exploited operationally, they are steadily increasing the strain on Russian logistics.

🇮🇷🇺🇸 Instead of trying to shoot U.S. aircraft out of the sky, Iran is taking away the runways. There's a name for it now: debasification. And by the numbers, it's working. Prewar, the U.S. could run operations against Iran from roughly 20 airbases. Strip out Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE, Saudi and Jordan and you're down to about five. Hundreds of airframes compressed onto a handful of tarmacs, with less time between launch detection and impact than it takes to get them airborne. More planes parked, more hits. Jordan was supposed to be the fallback. Per NYT reporting, 4 Iranian strikes there in a week produced casualties and aircraft losses, including personnel killed at Muwaffaq Salti. Interception rates in the footage look nothing like the official ones. And the retreat carries its own penalty. Pull back to Israel and every tanker now flies a thousand-plus miles to reach Iran's border. More when carrier aircraft are launching from 1,700 miles out in the Arabian Sea. No tankers, no loiter time. No loiter time, no suppressing Iranian air defenses. No suppression, no cheap bombs. And the cruise missile stocks are already thin. The one lever left is accepting losses the U.S. hasn't accepted in a generation. Is Washington willing to pull it? Source: Amerikanets on Substack / Writer: Oliver

⚓️📰 #USNAVY UPDATE: MSC Ships Provide Logistics Support During RIMPAC 2026 PACIFIC OCEAN — In the bright, blue waters surrounding the Hawaiian Islands, Military Sealift Command (MSC) Combat Logistics Force (CLF) ships are providing the fuel, supplies, and sustainment that keep the world's largest international maritime exercise underway. Fleet replenishment oiler USNS Guadalupe (T-AO 200) and dry cargo/ammunition ship USNS Washington Chambers (T-AKE 11) are supporting Exercise Rim of the Pacific 2026 by delivering aviation fuel, marine diesel fuel, food, equipment, and other supplies to the 36 U.S. and foreign Navy surface ships participating in the exercise. The ships are conducting multiple replenishment-at-sea (RAS) operations nearly every day, allowing participating forces to remain at sea and focused on mission objectives. While RAS operations are routine for MSC's CLF ships, the pace of RIMPAC is anything but routine. Instead of servicing one or two ships in a day, Guadalupe and Washington Chambers often conduct multiple replenishments daily, with ships receiving fuel and cargo simultaneously on both sides. "The ability to refuel and resupply ships at sea is the logistics backbone that keeps the exercise force sustained and ready," said Capt. Aaron Caputo, civil service master of Washington Chambers. "MSC's ability to deliver fuel, cargo, and logistics support allows U.S. and partner nation ships to remain on station and continue operations throughout RIMPAC."

Сьогодні за підсумками кількаденного спілкування з командирами наших корпусів, які виконують найважливіші бойові завдання, провів спеціальну зустріч Ставки. Вперше було пряме, безпосереднє спілкування основних наших виробників зброї та обладнання з командирами корпусів, які реально використовують продукцію, міністерствами оборони України та фінансів, а також основними спеціальними службами нашої держави. У Ставці взяли участь командувач ДШВ ЗСУ, командири 10-го, 11-го, 19-го армійських корпусів, «Хартії» та «Азову» і представники цвіту нового українського оборонного сектору. Більшість питань абсолютно практичні – щодо реальних бойових потреб, гальмування в забезпеченні, невирішених питань в закупівлях, необхідного додаткового фінансування і контрактів на постачання: дрони всіх типів та НРК, далекобійні снаряди для артилерії, які потрібні фактично на кожному напрямку інтенсивних бойових дій, інше обладнання. Домовились, що буде започаткований регулярний формат саме такого спілкування між корпусами, виробниками й урядовими структурами за координації Міністерства оборони та РНБО. Окремо обговорили конкретні показники дефектів продукції, що були виявлені на рівні застосування у бойових підрозділах. Важливо, щоб виробники чули такі відгуки й оперативно виправляли те, що необхідно. На завтра призначив зустрічі ще з іншими командирами корпусів: відгук має бути від усієї нашої корпусної системи Сил оборони України. Продовжу визначати, які корективи в стратегію оборони України слід внести і які пріоритети у виробництві та постачанні у війська повинні бути реалізовані якнайшвидше. Багато питань щодо ППО і, відповідно, завдань для системи МЗС України та загалом нашої дипломатії. Вдячний усім сьогодні за відвертість, щирість і змістовність. Україна має увійти у серпень максимально посиленою та підготуватись до різних варіантів подій і поведінки Росії восени. Дякую всім, хто допомагає! Дякую кожному воїну, кожному підрозділу, які захищають наші позиції і знищують російські сили. Слава Україні!

Today, following several days of discussions with the commanders of our corps carrying out the most critical combat missions, I convened a special meeting of the Staff. For the first time, there was direct, first-hand dialogue between our leading weapons and equipment manufacturers, the commanders of corps who actually use their products, Ukraine’s Ministries of Defense and Finance, and our country's key special services. The meeting was attended by the Commander of the Airborne Assault Forces, the commanders of the 10th, 11th, and 19th Army Corps, the Khartiia and Azov Corps, as well as representatives of the finest of Ukraine's new defense industry. Most of the issues discussed were entirely practical: actual battlefield needs, delays in supplies, unresolved procurement issues, the additional funding required, and supply contracts for drones of all types and ground robotic systems, long-range artillery munitions needed on virtually every sector of intensive fighting, and other equipment. We agreed to establish a regular format for exactly this kind of dialogue between the corps, manufacturers, and government agencies, coordinated by the Ministry of Defense and the National Security and Defense Council. We also discussed specific rates of product defects identified during use by combat units. It is important that manufacturers hear this feedback and promptly address what needs to be fixed. I have scheduled meetings with other corps commanders for tomorrow as well. We need feedback from across the entire corps system of Ukraine's Defense Forces. I will continue determining what adjustments should be made to Ukraine's defense strategy and which production and military supply priorities must be implemented as quickly as possible. There were also many issues related to air defense and, accordingly, tasks for Ukraine's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and our diplomacy as a whole. I am grateful to everyone today for their openness, honesty, and substantive contributions. Ukraine must enter August as strong as possible and be prepared for different possible scenarios and Russia's behavior this fall. Thank you to everyone who is helping. Thank you to every warrior and every unit defending our positions and destroying Russian forces. Glory to Ukraine!

National water availability data at your fingertips! 💧🎉 The National Water Availability Assessment Data Companion provides regularly updated, model-based estimates of water availability and use on a national scale. Nearly 27 million Americans, or 8% of the U.S. population, live in areas where water demand consistently approaches or exceeds naturally available water supply. Until recently, accessing comprehensive water availability information with national coverage required stitching together disparate datasets across multiple agencies, regions, and complicated websites. The Data Companion eliminates these barriers by: 💧 Providing consistent information about water availability and use across approximately 80,000 watersheds nationwide from 2000 to 2020 💧 Enabling data access through various user-friendly means, including a subset and download tool, a data file directory, an API, and a new interactive map 💧 Continually adding new and updated data to reflect the latest USGS water models and science Check out the interactive map now: water.usgs.gov/nwaa-data/ 📷 1: View of soil moisture data for January 2020 across the lower 48 United States from the Data Companion web mapper.

67 WHO Collaborating Centres (CCs) in the United Kingdom 🇬🇧 represent one of the world's strongest networks of public health expertise. Today, together with WHO Assistant Director-General Dr @JeremyFarrar, I joined the national meeting of @WHO CCs in the UK and thanked them for carrying forward a partnership that began in 1952 with the designation of the country’s first Collaborating Centre. From infectious diseases and antimicrobial resistance to mental health and emergency preparedness, these centres generate the evidence and solutions that countries rely on to tackle today's biggest health challenges. Under the new European Programme of Work, our priority is to make the WHO CC network even more connected across disciplines and regions, so together we can train the next generation of health professionals, strengthen health systems and turn scientific excellence into better health for people. Today's meeting was an excellent opportunity to explore how we can take this forward. I am grateful to Prof. Chris Whitty, Chief Medical Officer for England, and Mr Matthew Harpur of @DHSCgovuk for convening this meeting and to all WHO Collaborating Centres for helping improve health not only in the UK, but around the world.

(DELTA Act)'च्या मसुद्यासंदर्भात बैठक पार पडली. राज्याला 2030 पर्यंत '1 ट्रिलियन डॉलर' अर्थव्यवस्था बनण्याचे उद्दिष्ट साध्य करताना नवनवीन उत्पन्नाचे स्रोत विकसित करावे लागणार आहेत. त्याअनुषंगाने स्थावर मालमत्तांमध्ये असलेले सुप्त मूल्य लक्षात घेऊन या मूल्याचा सार्वजनिक हितार्थ उपयोग करण्यासाठी नवीन डेल्टा (महाराष्ट्र डिजिटायझेशन अँड एक्सचेंज ऑफ लँड टोकन असेट्स) कायदा प्रस्तावित करण्याचे तसेच या कायद्यामध्ये मालमत्तांचे 'सुप्त मूल्य' उपयोगात आणण्याचे सामर्थ्य असावे, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. सर्वसमावेशक आणि सर्व घटकांना अंतर्भूत करणाऱ्या अशा सर्वंकष कायद्याच्या निर्मितीसाठी सेबी, बीएसई, एनएसई आणि या क्षेत्रातील तज्ञ व अनुभवी व्यक्तींचा समावेश असलेली समिती गठित करण्याचे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. ब्लॉकचेन पद्धतीद्वारे स्थावर मालमत्तांना टोकन देऊन त्यांचे मूल्यवर्धन केले जाणार जगभरात मालमत्तांचे टोकनायझेशन करून उत्पन्नाचे नवे स्रोत निर्माण करण्याबरोबरच त्यांच्या मूल्यवर्धनाला चालना दिली जात आहे. त्याच धर्तीवर ब्लॉकचेन तंत्रज्ञानाच्या माध्यमातून स्थावर मालमत्तांचे टोकनायझेशन करून त्यांच्या सुप्त मूल्याचा प्रभावी वापर करता येईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. यासाठी जगभरात प्रचलित असलेल्या कायदे, नियम आणि कार्यपद्धतींचा सखोल अभ्यास करण्यात यावा. अशा स्वरूपाचा कायदा प्रस्तावित करणारे महाराष्ट्र हे देशातील पहिले राज्य ठरणार आहे. देशाला दिशादर्शक कायदे देण्याची समृद्ध परंपरा महाराष्ट्राने कायम जपली असून, प्रस्तावित 'डेल्टा' कायदाही त्या परंपरेला साजेसा ठरून राज्याचे नेतृत्व अधोरेखित करणारा असावा, अशी अपेक्षा मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी व्यक्त केली. ब्लॉकचेन पद्धतीद्वारे विकसित होणारी ही संपूर्ण व्यवस्था डिजिटल असणार आहे. या पद्धतीद्वारे जमिनीच्या मूल्यानुसार टोकन देऊन व्यवहार होतील. या संपूर्ण प्रक्रियेत अशा व्यवहारांना कायदेविषयक संरक्षण असणे अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे. त्यासाठी महाराष्ट्राने पुढाकार घेत डेल्टा कायदा आणण्याचे प्रस्तावित केले आहे. हा कायदा बनवीत असताना त्यामध्ये कसलीही कमतरता राहू नये यासाठी या क्षेत्रातील संस्था, नामवंत तज्ज्ञ, अभ्यासक आणि स्टार्टअप्स यांच्या अनुभवाचा उपयोग करावा. कायद्यामध्ये ब्लॉकचेनद्वारे होणाऱ्या व्यवहारांमध्ये मालमत्तेची मालकी निश्चित असावी. संपूर्ण प्रक्रिया डिजिटल होणार सध्या अस्तित्वात असलेल्या प्रक्रियेत खरेदी-विक्रीचे व्यवहार असो किंवा बँकांना कर्ज तारण करून देण्याची प्रक्रिया वेळखाऊ आहे. ही संपूर्ण प्रक्रिया डिजिटल करीत टोकनायझेशनच्या स्वरूपामध्ये आणल्यास गतिशीलता येईल. तसेच आपल्या मालमत्तेचे सुप्त मूल्य ओळखून मोठा लाभ संबंधित मालमत्ता धारकाला होऊ शकेल, याबाबत केंद्र शासनाच्या नियमांचाही अभ्यास करावा, अशा पद्धतीचा कायदा महाराष्ट्रात आणण्यासाठी नगरविकास, विधी व न्याय विभाग यांनी कार्यवाहीला गती द्यावी, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. Your daily reminder that free market & capitalism are two exact opposites : Dean W. Ball (@deanwball) Some observations on Kimi: 1. It's a very good model! I don't think its performance can be explained away by distillation or anything like that. In agentic coding sessions, it seems pretty much on par with the best public models of Q1 2026. In my fairly limited use, it also seemed very token hungry. It's not obvious to me that this model is actually that cheap to run. 2. I am personally surprised the Chinese state continues to allow the open sourcing of models this good, given potential risks. To be clear, I *myself* might be fine with models presenting this level of marginal risk being open weight, but I am surprised that China is fine with it. I suspect the reason they are is 75% explained by strategic blindness/lack of AGI-pilledness (the CCP is very Yann Lecun-y in its views of AI). The other 25% or so is their lack of compute for customer inference (making China's open-weight strategy an unintended byproduct of US export controls) and the normal Chinese strategy of aggressive exports. For the companies, as opposed to the government, the decision to open source is partially ideological and partially because they are behind, and they know that very few people would pay for sub-frontier models from China. 3. Open-weight models are inherently decelerationist, and I'm continually surprised to see the so-called "accelerationists" so excited about open-weight models. I suspect the reason they are is that they know open-weight models are effectively ungovernable, and they simply like the overall cloak of ungovernability open-weight models create over the whole of AI. It's not a bad strategy; it reminds me of James Scott's recounting of the hill people in "the art of not being governed." Still, in the end, open-weight models deter further AI capex. 4. One probable outcome of an open-weight-model-dominant world is full AI communism, which is precisely what China proposes: rather than a market product, AI is a "public good" which will ultimately be provided by the state as a kind of "digital public infrastructure." This future strikes me as a dystopian hellscape, but I've never met an open-weight models advocate who doesn't ultimately concede this is where things end. You'd be surprised how many 'accelerationists' lobbied me, while I was in government, to support an eleven or twelve-figure federally funded data center so that startups could train models at a subsidy and then give them away for free. There was no other way for AI to progress, they said. Perhaps this is the logical end state of things. Nonetheless, I find myself surprised to see supposed accelerationists excited about such an outcome. I think many of them just don't know what they're doing. Many accelerationists do not view the creation and serving of frontier models as a legitimate business. 5. I would guess that the Trump Administration will at some point realize that their best strategy here would be to create large amounts of regulatory risk around the use of open-weight Chinese models. You don't need to "ban open source" (one of the dumber motifs of AI policy discussion). You just need to direct every agency to issue soft law that creates FUD. "A Federal Reserve Advisory Bulletin found that there may be backdoors in Chinese AI models." It needn't be that well justified. You just create enough regulatory risk that every regulated enterprise backs off. You probably don't want to create so much regulatory risk that you scare off the hyperscalers from serving Chinese models; this will just drive startups to sketchier providers. There's a happy middle ground here. I'd assume they will do some version of this. 6. It's probably true that open-weight models of this capability make the world a bit more dangerous, but not so much more that you'll really notice. At some point the models will be capable enough that you will notice. "A nonliving, invisible, dangerous, and infinitely self-replicating agent escaped from a Chinese lab," you say? Color me shocked. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/deanwball/status/2078133895766114412#m

250,000 books. That is how many my Ukrainian publisher, Knygolove knigolove.ua/ lost on 19 July after three Russian Iskander missiles struck the warehouse outside Kyiv. Among them were my books, too. This is war, and war inevitably brings human and material losses. But when books burn, it is not just paper that burns. Culture, memory, and identity burn with them. So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

Through her leadership, she helped strengthen the inter-American agenda for women’s rights, political participation, equality, and the prevention and eradication of violence against women, including through the implementation of the Convention of Belém do Pará. Her wisdom, diplomatic skill, and lifelong commitment to public service earned her the respect and admiration of colleagues throughout the Americas. Her legacy will continue to inspire those working to build a more equal, just, and peaceful hemisphere. I extend my heartfelt condolences to her family, friends, former colleagues, and to the Government and people of #Mexico. Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog, visited Gyekar Sinyik (Ganga Lake) in Arunachal Pradesh to assess its potential for sustainable eco-tourism and discuss measures to strengthen climate resilience and disaster preparedness. Senior officials from NITI Aayog, NDMA, the Central Water Commission, and other concerned agencies were also present. The visit included discussions with local officials and communities on the need for scientific studies of the lake's hydrology, geology, and catchment dynamics to better understand changing water levels and inform long-term risk mitigation strategies. The delegation also explored sustainable and technically feasible measures to preserve the lake's ecological integrity while reducing disaster risks. Dr. Joram Aniya emphasised the importance of balancing environmental conservation with scientific planning and community well-being to promote sustainable development in ecologically fragile regions. The visit reaffirmed NITI Aayog's commitment to advancing climate resilience, ecological stewardship, and sustainable tourism in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat. #ArunachalPradesh #SustainableTourism @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

मराठी भाषा संवर्धनासाठी राज्य मराठी विकास संस्थेला अधिक सक्षम करण्यावर भर मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे 'राज्य मराठी विकास संस्थे'च्या नियामक मंडळाची बैठक पार पडली. राज्य मराठी विकास संस्थेच्या कामकाजात सातत्य, पारदर्शकता आणि परिणामकारकता यावी, यासाठी वर्षभरातील सर्व वैधानिक बैठकींचे वेळापत्रक पूर्वनियोजन करून निश्चित करावे. तसेच प्रभावी कृती आराखडा तयार करून त्याची अंमलबजावणी करावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. राज्य मराठी विकास संस्थेची सर्व वैधानिक अनुपालने पूर्ण झाल्याबद्दल संस्थेचे अभिनंदन करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, संस्थेतील गेल्या काही वर्षांपासूनचा प्रशासकीय व वैधानिक अनुशेष दूर झाल्याने संस्थेची प्रशासकीय रचना अधिक सक्षम व परिणामकारक झाली आहे. आता मराठी भाषेचा प्रचार, प्रसार, संशोधन आणि संवर्धन यासाठी ठोस धोरणे राबविण्यावर भर देणे आवश्यक आहे. संस्थेच्या कर्मचाऱ्यांचे प्रलंबित प्रश्नही सकारात्मक भूमिकेतून सोडविण्यात येतील. या बैठकीत सदस्यांनी मराठी भाषा आणि विविध बोलींच्या संवर्धनासाठी अनेक महत्त्वपूर्ण सूचना मांडल्या. 'पुस्तकांचे गाव' आणि 'पेटी वाचनालय' उपक्रमांचा विस्तार करून आदिवासी व सीमावर्ती भागातील मराठी शाळांपर्यंत दर्जेदार साहित्य पोहोचविणे, झाडीबोली आणि पूर्व विदर्भातील नाट्यपरंपरेच्या जतनासाठी गडचिरोली-वडसा परिसरात नाट्यसंकुल उभारणे, भारुड, गोंधळ, पोवाडा यांसारख्या लोककलांच्या माध्यमातून मराठीचा वारसा जपणे, तसेच बालसाहित्य व बालग्रंथालयांना प्रोत्साहन देण्याबाबत सूचना मांडल्या. या सर्व सूचनांचा सकारात्मकतेने विचार करण्यात येईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी सांगितले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी तंजावर येथील मोडी लिपीतील सुमारे 15 लाख ऐतिहासिक कागदपत्रांच्या डिजिटायझेशन प्रकल्पाच्या प्रगतीचा आढावा घेतला. तसेच लंडन येथे महाराष्ट्राचे आराध्यदैवत छत्रपती शिवाजी महाराज यांच्या नावाने उभारण्यात येणाऱ्या जागतिक मराठी केंद्राच्या कामाला गती देण्याबाबतही चर्चा झाली. यावेळी मंत्री उदय सामंत, महाराष्ट्र राज्य साहित्य आणि संस्कृती मंडळाचे अध्यक्ष, ज्येष्ठ साहित्यिक प्रा. सदानंद मोरे, राज्य मराठी विकास संस्थेचे संचालक डॉ. श्यामकांत देवरे आणि वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @samant_uday #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #मराठीभाषा

The European Union is Kenya's largest single export destination and a strategic bilateral partner. Our decades-long relations have been boosted by the signing of the European Partnership Agreement (EPA) in July 2024. The EPA provides Kenyan goods, including cut flowers, tea, coffee, and horticulture, duty-free free and quota-free access to the EU market. On its part, the European Union exports to Kenya machinery, chemical and mineral products. Since the signing of EPA, our trade has increased by 20 per cent, bringing annual trade to $3.8 billion (KSh494 billion). Our comprehensive relationship also spans digital innovation, climate resilience and regional security. Bid farewell to European Union Ambassador Henriette Geiger at State House Nairobi. During the time the envoy represented the EU in our country, our ties have significantly strengthened.

Kenya and Belgium share strong bilateral and diplomatic relations anchored on trade and investment, renewable energy and climate action. These ties have been boosted by my recent business roundtable in Brussels in June 2026. On trade, Belgium is the leading destination for Kenyan coffee. The ASEAN Secretariat participated in the ASEAN-India Scale Hub 2026 held in Bali, Indonesia, from 15–17 July 2026. The programme convened over 334 participants, including 57 growth-stage scale-ups from ASEAN Member States and India, alongside investors, policymakers, technology providers, and ecosystem partners to explore opportunities for regional expansion, investment, and collaboration. Through curated business matchmaking sessions, smart pitches, workshops, and high-level discussions, participants exchanged insights on artificial intelligence (AI), digital transformation, startup scaling, enterprise partnerships, and innovation-driven growth, aiming to translate innovative ideas into sustainable commercial opportunities across ASEAN and India. This year's edition also marked an important milestone with the first participation of Timor-Leste and a stronger emphasis on growth-stage and deep-tech enterprises. Unlike previous editions, the programme featured focused discussions on scaling AI-driven businesses, while providing structured opportunities for scale-ups to engage directly with investors, technology providers, and ecosystem leaders across the region. Rome conquered Greece in 146 BC when they burned Corinth to the ground. And then the strangest thing in ancient history happened. The winners spent the next few centuries desperately trying to become the losers. It actually started before the final conquest. When the general Marcellus sacked Syracuse in 211 BC, he shipped boatloads of Greek statues and paintings back to Rome, and the city went crazy for it. Suddenly every rich Roman had to have Greek art in his house. Decades later Cicero built an entire court case around prosecuting a governor named Verres for looting Greek masterpieces, and Romans ate it up. Then came the schools. Wealthy families started buying Greek slaves specifically because they were educated, and handed them the job of raising their children. So the sons of the men who crushed Greece grew up speaking Greek, memorizing Greek poetry, and learning philosophy from Greeks. The elite eventually sent their teenagers abroad to Athens and Rhodes to finish their education, the way people today send kids to study overseas. Cicero did it. Julius Caesar did it. Their gods were Greek gods wearing name tags. Zeus became Jupiter. Hera became Juno. Aphrodite became Venus. Ares became Mars. Same myths, same family drama, mostly just relabeled. Their entertainment was borrowed too. The first big Roman playwrights, Plautus and Terence, basically adapted Greek comedies into Latin. Their doctors were Greek. Their architecture leaned on Greek columns, the Doric and Ionic and Corinthian orders you still see on bank buildings today. And the art obsession left a strange fingerprint on history. Romans loved Greek bronze statues so much that they mass produced marble copies of them. A huge chunk of what people walk past in museums today and call "Greek sculpture" is actually a Roman copy. The Greek originals melted down or vanished long ago. The knockoffs are what survived. Not everyone was thrilled. Cato the Elder spent his whole life warning that Greek culture would rot the Roman character. He sneered at Greek philosophers, distrusted Greek doctors, and wanted them kept out of the city. And then, as an old man, he quietly sat down and learned Greek anyway. Even the loudest hater caved. The trend went all the way to the top. Virgil wrote the Aeneid, Rome's national epic, by openly modeling it on Homer. The emperor Nero competed in Greek games and toured Greece like a superfan. Hadrian was so obsessed he grew a Greek philosopher's beard and poured money into rebuilding Athens. And Marcus Aurelius, master of the entire Roman world, wrote his private journal not in Latin but in Greek, because that was the language of serious thinking. The poet Horace nailed it in a single line: captured Greece took her savage conqueror captive. Rome won every war on the battlefield and then handed its whole soul to the people it had beaten.

H.E. Ms. Anita Anand, Foreign Minister of Canada calls on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 20 July, 2026.

Islamabad : 20 July , 2026. H.E. Ms. Anita Anand, Foreign Minister of Canada, who is on an official visit to Pakistan, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House, earlier today. Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Minister for National Food Security Rana Tanveer Hussain, Advisor to the Prime Minister Dr. Syed Tauqir Shah, and other senior government officials were also present. During the warm and cordial meeting, the Prime Minister welcomed the Canadian Foreign Minister to Pakistan and stated that the two countries enjoyed friendly ties that needed to be further expanded, particularly in the areas of trade, investment, agriculture including agri-foods and vaccine manufacturing, renewable energy, as well as the automobile and auto parts industry. He conveyed his greetings and best wishes for Prime Minister Mark Carney and said that he looked forward to meeting him soon. He fondly recalled the telephone conversation with his Canadian counterpart in April, and thanked Canada for supporting Pakistan’s regional peace efforts. Foreign Minister Anita Anand thanked the Prime Minister for the warm welcome accorded to her and her delegation in Islamabad. She conveyed the good wishes of Prime Minister Carney for the Prime Minister and said that her visit was on the instructions of her Prime Minister to expand Canada’s relations with Pakistan. On the bilateral front, the Canadian Foreign Minister expressed the keen desire of her Government to explore new opportunities for trade and cooperation, especially in the field of agriculture, mining, energy as well as in the auto and auto parts industry. In this regard, she said the Foreign Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (FIPPA) would be instrumental in enhancing Canadian investors’ confidence to invest in Pakistan. Both sides agreed that the Pakistani Canadian community was acting as a vital bridge between the two nations. The two sides also agreed to exchange delegations in the fields of trade and minerals cooperation, to explore mutually beneficial opportunities, with a view to further enhance bilateral trade and investment prospects. After the meeting, the Prime Minister witnessed the signing of a Protocol on Phyto-sanitary regulations governing the import of Canola from Canada to Pakistan. The Protocol was signed by the Deputy Prime Minister and the Canadian Foreign Minister from their respective sides. Video

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 and Canada's Minister of Foreign Affairs, H.E. Anita Anand @AnitaAnandMP, signed the Protocol on the Phytosanitary Import Requirements for Genetically Modified Canola Intended for Food, Feed and Processing (FFP) from Canada to Pakistan at the Prime Minister's Office. The signing ceremony was witnessed by Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif @CMShehbaz. The Protocol establishes the phytosanitary import requirements for Canadian genetically modified canola intended for food, feed and processing and reflects the shared commitment of Pakistan and Canada to strengthening bilateral cooperation in agriculture and trade.

If social media posts of Judge Hamayoun Dilawar are authentic (Tosha Khana Case Judge), this is alarming and raises serious and reasonable doubts on credibility of trial being conducted by him. In my view, propriety demands that he should immediately recuse or disassociate himself from the case. It needs to be noted that Seven Member Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan in Malik Qayyum Case (reported in 2001 PLD SC 568) held that bias on part of the judge vitiates judicial proceedings. The court further held that an accused has a right of a fair trial by a judicial minded person, not by someone functioning under an influence or bias as the same paralyses his judicial faculties to conduct fair trial. Bias would vitiate judicial proceedings if such circumstances exist. Bias robs the judge of the confidence that a litigant may have in the judge. Court further held that bias is mental disposition or attitude towards a particular person and covers all kind of hostilities and prejudices against him.

#DidYouKnow that Manipur celebrates the #RathYatra, locally known as ‘Kang Chingba’? The annual chariot festival is marked by great devotion & splendour as it begins at the Shri Govindaji Temple in Imphal, where devotees gather to offer special prayers before joining the grand ceremonial procession. The festival, celebrated amidst the sounds of cymbals & chants, has been an integral part of Manipur’s cultural & religious heritage since 1832. Beautifully blending Vaishnavite traditions with indigenous Meitei customs, it attracts devotees from all over the country to participate in the 10-day celebration, which concludes with ‘Kang Len’ or Poornayatra, marking the ceremonial return of Lord Jagannath, Lord Balabhadra, and Devi Subhadra to their traditional abode. Hon. Foreign Minister Mr Shisir Khanal received Mr Scott Urbom, US Chargé d'Affaires a.i., and Mr Mike Harker, Public Affairs Chief at the U.S. Embassy, at the Ministry today. On the occasion, the Hon. Minister congratulated Mr Harker on his successful ascent of Mt Everest and commended his remarkable achievement as the first US diplomat to summit the world's highest peak. Appreciating his contribution to promoting Nepal's adventure tourism, the Hon. Minister encouraged Mr Harker to continue promoting Nepal as a premier destination for adventure and nature tourism in the US and beyond. Mr Harker successfully climbed Mt Everest on 20 May 2026, becoming the first US diplomat to stand atop the world's highest peak.

Heads of the United Nations Agencies based in Kathmandu paid a joint courtesy call on Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs Mr Shisir Khanal at the Ministry today. The United Nations Resident Coordinator and the Heads of UNDP, WFP, UNESCO, UNODC, UNRCPD, UNICEF, UNFPA and WHO were present for the joint call on. Hon. Foreign Minister reaffirmed Nepal's unwavering commitment to the United Nations as well as a strong and inclusive multilateral system. He appreciated the UN's longstanding partnership in advancing Nepal's journey to development and prosperity and called for an enhanced level of cooperation in the days ahead. Hon. Minister Khanal further underscored the Government's priorities of strengthening good governance, accelerating economic transformation, creating employment opportunities, and harnessing the demographic dividend to achieve sustainable, inclusive and resilient development. On the occasion, the Heads of the UN agencies highlighted the ongoing cooperation between the UN Agencies and Nepal, reiterated their support for Nepal's national priorities and expressed commitment to further strengthening Nepal-UN partnership.

CARICOM pays tribute to the courage, dedication and selfless efforts of the rescue teams and all who are responding in the aftermath of the incident, led by relevant arms of the Government of Guyana, and including private vessel operators, who mobilized overnight in challenging conditions to save lives. CARICOM stands in solidarity with the Government and people of Guyana, in particular, the families and communities that are being impacted by this unfolding disaster.

"Who says spreading your wings means flying high? Flying low is also flying," reads a line from Low Flight, a poetry collection by Wang Jibing. The book has earned him the Lu Xun Literary Prize, one of China's top literary honors. But what makes the news particularly striking is that Wang is a food delivery rider. Born in east China's Jiangsu Province, Wang, now 56, left school as a teenager due to his family financial hardship. He took on a variety of jobs – from construction work to running a street stall. He eventually chose to become a delivery rider, not only because it paid better, but also because it allowed him to observe passers-by and the scenery along the way, making it easier to capture inspiration for his writing. He had been posting his poems and essays on social media over the past decade, but they failed to make much of a splash. Then came 2019, when a customer entered the wrong address, causing Wang to miss the delivery window. The customer sneered, "You're this old and still delivering food? How stupid can you be?" After that frustrating experience, he wrote a piece titled "Man in a Hurry." It went viral online, and Wang soon became well-known. He began gathering material for his poetry, interviewing and surveying other delivery riders and drawing inspiration from their stories. In 2024, Low Flight was published. The collection vividly portrays this group of workers – though they are at the bottom of society, they still yearn for a better life. Wang's achievement reflects a broader trend: more and more blue-collar workers in China are carving out a place for themselves in different areas. #TheFaces

اسلام آباد: 20 جولائی، 2026. وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیرِ صدارت پاکستان ریلویز ٹرانسفارمیشن پلان پر پیش رفت کا جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پاکستان ریلویز مسافروں اور مال برداری کے لیے سب سے کم لاگت اور مؤثر ذریعۂ نقل و حمل ہے. جدید اور مؤثر ریلوے نظام ملکی معیشت، تجارت اور علاقائی روابط کے فروغ میں کلیدی کردار ادا کرے گا. پاکستان ریلویز کے بنیادی ڈھانچے کی جدید کاری کا پاکستان کے علاقائی تجارت اور لاجسٹکس ہب کے طور پر کردار میں کلیدی کردار ہوگا. وزیراعظم نے ہدایات دیں کہ ریلوے کے ترقیاتی منصوبوں کو اعلیٰ معیار اور مقررہ مدت کے اندر مکمل کیا جائے اور مین ریلوے لائین ون کے روہڑی-ملتان سیکشن کی اپ گریڈیشن کے حوالےسے تجاویز پیش کی جائیں. اجلاس کو ایم ایل-1 اور ایم ایل-3 اپ گریڈیشن، تھر کول ریلوے کنیکٹیویٹی اور دیگر منصوبوں کی پیشرفت پر بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ ایم ایل-1 کی کراچی۔روہڑی سیکشن کے لیے تفصیلی انجینئرنگ ڈیزائن مکمل کر لی گئی ہے. ایم ایل 3 روہڑی-نوکنڈی کی اپ گریڈیشن پی ایس ڈی پی اور برج فنانسنگ تحت کی جائے گی. تھر کول ریل کنینٹیویٹی منصوبے کا 112 کلومیٹر طویل ریلوے ٹریک تھر کول تا چھور ریلوے اسٹیشن پر 60 فیصد کام ہو چکا اور یہ منصوبہ دسمبر 2026 تک مکمل کر لیا جائے گا. بریفنگ میں مزید بتایا گیا کہ وزیراعظم کی ہدایت پر ریلوے کی اصلاحات کے لئے بین الاقوامی کنسلٹنٹ کی خدمات حاصل کر لی گئی ہیں. ریلوے کے ماتحت اسکول اور ہسپتالوں کی سروسز کو آوٹ سورس کیا جا چکا ہے، جبکہ چھ بڑے ریلوے اسٹیشنوں کی کمرشلائزیشن پر کام کا آغاز کیا جا رہا ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی منصوبہ بندی احسن اقبال، وفاقی وزیر اقتصادی امور احد خان چیمہ، وفاقی وزیر ریلوے حنیف عباسی، وفاقی وزیر انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی و ٹیلی کام شزا فاطمہ، مشیر وزیر اعظم برائے نجکاری محمد علی، وزیر مملکت برائے خزانہ و ریلوے بلال اظہر کیانی اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ سرکاری افسران نے شرکت کی۔ Video

Today's Ramsar Spotlight takes us to Ashtamudi Wetland in Kerala. The name "Ashtamudi" means "eight coned" in Malayalam, referring to the estuary's intricate network of waterways. Over centuries, the historic port city of Kollam on its banks welcomed traders from Persia, China and Europe, shaping a rich cultural landscape. Today, the wetland comes alive each November during the President's Trophy Boat Race, when traditional Chundan Vallams (snake boats) transform its tranquil waters into a vibrant racecourse. #WetlandsofIndia

The World Heritage Site of Dholavira stands as one of the finest examples of the urban ingenuity of Ancient Bharat during 3000-1500 BCE. Its systematically planned layout, advanced water conservation system, humongous reservoirs, elaborately crafted gateways and fortification and large cache of fine artefacts reflect an extraordinary level of engineering and town planning achieved over four and a half millennia ago. Excavated by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) between 1989 and 2005, Dholavira has revealed invaluable insights into one of the world’s earliest urban settlements. Today, this remarkable site continues to inspire scholars and visitors alike, showcasing the innovation, resilience, and architectural excellence of India’s ancient past. Video

India once clothed the world, accounting for a quarter of global economic output in 1700. Today, its share of global apparel exports sits at around 3%, roughly where it has stagnated for two decades even as Bangladesh's rose from 2.2% to 9% and Vietnam's from 1% to 6%. In their recent op-ed in @IndianExpress & @FinancialXpress, Prof. Ashok Gulati (@agulati115), Distinguished Professor at ICRIER, and Dr. Sulakshana Rao, Senior Fellow at ICRIER, ask what it will take for India to raise its apparel export share in a $521-billion global apparel market. Drawing on their new book, Stitching India's Apparel Export Strategy: From Farm to Foreign, they lay out an ecosystem approach to competitiveness built on five pillars: scale and ecosystem, capital, labour and skilling, clusters and institutions, and market access and trade facilitation. The piece examines the "missing middle" of mid-sized export-ready firms, the need to expand the apparel manufacturing to labour abundant regions like central and eastern India, the cotton-skewed fibre mix that sits out of step with a man-made-fibre-dominated global market, and how initiatives like PM-MITRA and recent FTAs with the UK and EU could help reposition India as a scale-driven, sustainable global sourcing hub. Read the full op-ed: indianexpress.com/article/op… Financial Express: financialexpress.com/opinion…
